M25.title_zh: 变化中的对齐：纠正、查询与接续
M25.title_en: Alignment through change: correction, inquiry and succession
M25.claim_zh: 明确G0/J规范基础评价目的与选择规则；观察可用的查询和回应共同保留实际纠正，宏观选择通过有资金支持的忠实载体交接接入真实命令执行。 后续实际检查形成未预列的纠正地址；局部成功见证与给定范围的穷尽分开，重新核验当前配置与权限。 再接续将相关故障范围分别用于观察与委托许可；取得真实路线、保持委托范围并接到付费执行及防重放。 本轮由明确共同原因与公式计算故障范围，再接入保留委托、新权限版本和纠正预算的原子组织改革。
M25.claim_en: Explicit G0/J grounds appraise ends and selectors; observation-usable inquiry and response jointly preserve actual correction, while funded faithful carrier transfer refines aggregate selection into real command execution. Subsequent inspection forms unlisted correction addresses, separates local success from scoped exhaustion, and rechecks current configuration and authority. A further continuation applies correlated fault envelopes separately to observation and delegated permission, deriving actual routes, mandate fidelity, paid execution and replay rejection. Causal formulas now compute reviewer fault envelopes, supporting atomic organizational reform that retains the mandate, renews authority labels and reserves correction capacity.
M25.scope_zh: 四项条件性理论成果完成；59项新Lean定理／102项声明审计和14,295项有限记录匹配。42项空依赖，其余仅标准公理。保留遗漏模型、查询耗尽、权限失效、部件不足、失真交接及迁移资金不足。常规有限规划匹配；真实部署、任意发现及普遍收敛未证。作者反审，不冒充独立验收。 接续另有24项新定理／45项审计、25,284项匹配记录；21项空依赖，其余仅标准公理。有限忠实界面、检查成本和原子执行明确；权限俘获不由凭据相等解决。 部分失陷接续另有37项新定理／68项审计、85,680项匹配记录（29项空依赖）。可用性要求任意两个纳入故障集合不覆盖全部审查者；真实故障覆盖、受保护执行边界与委托正当性仍须根据。 最终执行器直接检查受保护委托范围；原仅凭认证的失陷失败保留。 组织改革另增28项定理／48项审计、33,648项匹配记录（28项声明空依赖）；共同控制、重复支承、遗漏原因及预算不足反例保留。因果描述与根原因覆盖、改革授权、受保护的原子实现仍给定；非分布式迁移或伦理正当性证明。
M25.scope_en: Four scoped theoretical deliverables complete; 59 new Lean theorems / 102 declaration audits and 14,295 matched finite records. Forty-two empty dependencies; others use standard axioms only. Omitted models, inquiry depletion, authority failure, missing parts, corrupt transfer and migration underfunding remain. Conventional finite planning matches; deployment, arbitrary discovery and universal convergence are unestablished. Author counterreview, not independent acceptance. The continuation adds 24 theorems / 45 audits and 25,284 matched records; 21 empty dependencies, otherwise standard axioms. Finite faithful inspection, charged reads and atomic dispatch remain explicit; credential equality does not resolve authority capture. Partial-compromise work adds 37 theorems / 68 audits and 85,680 matched records (29 empty dependencies). Availability requires that no two admitted fault sets cover all reviewers; actual fault coverage, the protected boundary and mandate legitimacy still require warrant. The final executor directly checks the protected scope; the earlier attestation-only failure is retained. Reconfiguration adds 28 theorems / 48 audits and 33,648 matched records (28 declarations with empty dependencies). Shared control, duplicate support, omitted causes and inadequate budgets remain. Causal formulas/root coverage, reform approval and protected atomic realization are supplied; distributed migration and ethical legitimacy are not proved.
